title: Humans as slave workers in Eden

tellings.quote: out of the garden uh where by the way they were workers because you know the nakedness in antiquity was a sign of slave labor and [snorts] we were killers of the field in Eden for the gods except we didn't know it.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, offers a reading of Eden, the garden in the Bible's book of Genesis where the first humans lived. He says that in ancient times nakedness was a mark of slave labour, so the naked humans in the garden were really workers in the fields for the gods, without knowing it. If true, the Bible's opening story would describe humans as a labour force serving more powerful beings.
